title: Film strip
description: A film strip of five to eight stills runs from right to left through the middle of the frame (anime.js timeline). The still at the gate grows a little while the others step back, and the frame number and the caption under the film change with it. The film band is more than half of the slide height. One click per still on a slide; on a web page the block stays pinned and your scroll pushes the film. Nothing is drawn on the pictures.

props.items: required, 5-8 of {src: a 16:9 picture, label: small caps (for example the lesson), caption: 2-6 words, alt}
props.kicker: small caps above the film, on the left
props.title: one short line above the film, on the right
